feature: Deck stats, PR 1: the switch and the placement shell
note: Needs DECK_STATS_ENABLED=true on the server and STATS_DECK (any deck with cards). The list row shows the third segment beside Deck and Versions; the stats row presses it and shows six empty shells with the list tools hidden. Shells carry no data until the card PRs, so no row photographs a figure's contents.
